criterion: Repeated row actions identify their target
description: Background agent and run-history rows exposed repeated Edit, Test, Repo, Delete, Output, and Details controls without target-specific accessible names.
expected: Repeated row actions should include the agent, repository, or run target, such as `Test background agent Live Proof Background Agent` and `Open details for background run dennisonbertram/synthetix ...`.
actual: Multiple rows exposed identical `Edit`, `Test`, `Repo`, `Delete agent`, `Output`, and `Details` controls.
suggested_fix: Add target-specific accessible labels to background agent actions, webhook copy controls, and run output/details links.
